nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Super Fluid Daily UV Defense SPF 50+

avis.texte: This is a great product. It is very light weight and doesn't feel greasy on your skin like a lot of sunscreen products can.

Like other people said, it is SLIDING on my face, leave marks on where the sunglasses were. My face got pimples (yes, which I never had had in my life) really really bad. These are still here after months now. I decided to use it on my body, guess what? The seat, the door, the wheel, even the outside of my car had white cast. 😑 I don't get the hype of this product tbh.
It is a very nice product. Easy to apply and very clean for body. So worth having and it's a must have to my daily routine now.

avis.titre: I would buy this line again
avis.texte: I love it I used it all summer helped with my hyperpigmentation

I used this sunscreen ever day this past summer. I spend most days at the ballfield and typically come home with a red face. Not with this! It doesn't leave your face greasy and you can wear under makeup on top.eill definitely repurchase again and again!
Love this, very lightweight, doesn't pill on face. Very calming

I was a little skeptical trying this because of some of the reviews but I love this stuff. I am a faithful SPF user and this is now my favorite. It smells like sunblock to me so I don't understand the reviews regarding the smell. I took my family to Universal Studios for a couple of days and it was in the high 90s. I used another sunblock on one day and burned. Used this the other day and no sunburn. I do not use makeup primer when applying this and my makeup still stays fresh looking. There isn't any separating. I will be purchasing this product when I run out.

I love this sunscreen. I have sensitive skin and rosacea so it's hard finding a facial sunscreen that doesn't break me out. This keeps my face moisturized while being protected, and without causing breakouts.

This Kiehl's sunscreen is the most amazing sunscreen I have ever used on my face! This sunscreen makes my face feel glowy, hydrated and super soft. Every other sunscreen I have used would make my face super oily and nasty-feeling. Not this one! I am so impressed with this product, I will never use another! I absolutely love it.
This sunscreen is super lightweight and absorbs quickly. It doesn't feel too greasy or too drying. I didn't notice a significant white cast after it was fully absorbed.
It leaves a small white cast but will fade away after a few min. It is not heavy and feels lightweight on the skin.

avis.titre: Lightweight and wears well under makeup
avis.texte: I waited to use this on my trip to New Orleans and was not disappointed. It wears well, no residue, and no white sheen left behind. It handled me sensitive skin very well and worked as intended. No complaints

avis.titre: Great lightweight daily SPF from a name I trust.
avis.texte: Thanks for the opportunity to try the Kiehls Super Fluid in return for my review. First, I trust the quality of the Kiehls brand for a product I use daily on my face. It's lightweight and wears nicely under makeup and alone, without any white cast and you just need a small amount.

avis.titre: Make this part of your skin care routine
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. I use it as the last piece of my skin care routine prior to applying my make up. My skin feel soft and hydrated without feeling greasy, and it doesn't disturb any of my make up application all while protecting My skin from the sun.
Even you put this on your skin, it feels like a moisturizer that also protects you from the sun. It works great as a primer, as my makeup stayed on really well when I wore this under makeup
I really wanted to love this but it left my face feeling a little greasy. It also doesn't have the most pleasant odor. For the price, it should be better.

avis.titre: great, high quality lightweight daily sunscreen
avis.texte: **Review of Daily SPF 50 Lightweight Sunscreen for Face** I recently tried the Daily SPF 50 Lightweight Sunscreen for Face, and I'm impressed. The formula is incredibly light and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. It provides high sun protection, which is crucial for daily use, and it doesn't clog pores or irritate sensitive skin. The finish is smooth and matte, making it an excellent base for makeup. Additionally, it's fragrance-free, which is a plus for those with sensitivities. Overall, it's a reliable choice for anyone seeking effective sun protection with a weightless feel.
Easy to apply, lightweight, and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. Great addition to daily skincare routing.

I apply the product at the end of my skincare routine every morning. I've been using the Kiehl's super fluid daily UV defense sunscreen for a couple of weeks and I do not recommend it. I personally do not like it. First, the sunscreen has an unpleasant smell, like oil/petroleum/chemical. I dislike it. However, I like the fact that it's lightweight and smooth but it's a bit oily, too liquidity. And finally, it has a white cast. Even I who is fair skin can tell. It's not nice. I like the ingredient list and what the brand stands for but no thank you.

I received a free sample of KIEHL'S daily SPF 50+ in exchange for an honest review! I can honestly say, i'm very happy with the quality and results of this product! I've used this product for over a week now and it's been great. It's lightweight and goes on smooth. It's easy to apply, and a little goes a long way. This sunscreen absorbs quickly, and there no white cast. I would absolutely buy this product and recommend it to anyone who's seeking a new facial sunscreen! This product has been absolutely amazing.

I got this sample in return of honest feedback. This was one of the best sunscreen i have tried so far. Less greasy and still remain effective for hours of in hot sun. Very effective and quality product and must have for daily use

I love this sunscreen! Although it has a thinner texture than some sunscreen it absorbs easily and is very lightweight. I have very sensitive skin that often gets irritated and itchy from sunscreen but the Kiehl's didnt cause any issues. It also didn't clog my pores and offered fantastic protection. I'm a fan and will continue to use this product after being sent a sample to try out.

avis.titre: Great product for protection during my rides
avis.texte: After using it several times, I noticed a big difference in my arms and neck, because I didn't have the intense and painful sun marks as before and I was even more hydrated.
So easy to use and keeps makeup in place all day. I wore this to on outdoor concert in August. It rained as well as was really hot. My makeup didn't budge.
I've been using this sunscreen on my everyday routine and I just love it. Very fluid texture. No white cast or grease skin. I love to use also before my makeup. I highly recommend for dry skin.

I received this Kiehl's facial sunscreen for free in exchange for an honest review, and I've been using it for the past few weeks. Unlike other sunscreens I've tried, its lightweight, non-greasy formula is a pleasure to apply. Overall, I highly recommend this Kiehl's sunscreen - a little goes a long way, and the generous amount you get for the price means it will last a considerable time. Its on the pricy side.

I like its product because as a dark skinned person it doesn't leave a cast and as an oily skin girl it doesn't make me look greasy. I just wish it weren't so expensive. And it has a slightly weird smell. That thankfully doesn't linger, but you can smell it when you sniff the bottle.

I'm beyond content with this sunscreen! I'm a big fan of fluid sunscreens and this want has surpassed my expectations. It is light and sits beauty under makeup. It is not greasy nor does it irritate my eyes or skin. A big plus is that it does not leave a white cast. What impressed me the most is the beautiful texture it gives to your skin. I love knowing I'm protecting my skin while this product gives me the most beautiful feel and look to my face.

I've been having my daughter use this since she started 7th grade this school year as she spends a lot more time out in the sun than I do at my office job. It's thunk even after shaking but when spreading feels like an in between. It doesn't leave a white case which is good and doesn't seem to melt with sweat as my daughter hasn't complained about that.

avis.titre: Super light weight, soft matte finish.
avis.texte: Super impressed with how this feels. I am able to control how much product is dispensed as the bottle has a dropper type of tip, which eliminates waste or using too much. It applied smoothly without any greasiness or stickiness, without any form of white cast or shine. Feels very comfortable on, I even applied it to my freshly dermaplaned face and didn't not experience any interactions. I believe it's fragrance free, and to me it smells like neutral sunscreen. Very light weight considering it's really high SPF.

Keeps my skin hydrated from being out in the sun! Definitely doesn't leave a white cast which I love, but does have a slight burning sensation when first using and is pretty pricey. So in my routine I would mostly use it when I am doing things outdoors.
Wow, glad I received this sample. As a natural redhead, I'm always looking for a facial sunscreen that works. This fits the bill! Light weight, fast absorption and high SPF.

I was surprised by the unique, very thin texture, which makes it easy to apply and blend into the skin without the heavy, greasy feeling of other sunscreens. I also liked the mild fragrance as it's much less overpowering than others I've used. Make sure to apply this sunscreen to a clean face, as you can feel anything gritty while applying.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this product for future use!
avis.texte: What I love about this sunscreen is that it's light weight and very easy to blend in with your skin. I have oily skin and this sunscreen didn't clog my pores nor cause any excess oil or breakouts on my skin. I wore this sunscreen under my makeup . It provided excellent protection , overall coverage and worked very well with my makeup products.

I loved using this sunscreen. My daughter and I have sensitive skin so finding a sunscreen that doesn't break us out is hard. This worked amazingly and is very light weight. I was able to put my make up on over it with no problem.

I appreciate how lightweight this is, and how easily it is absorbed. There was no greasiness or stickiness either. It has the typical sunscreen smell, but I don't know if there is a way around that! Quality product. :)

This is one of my staples. Living in Miami, I use face sunscreen every day religiously, even on sunless days and in the office. I love this one! Zero white cast, melts into the skin, easy to apply make up after without piling. Fun packaging too,

Decent product I was surprised while using this product as most sunscreens are heavy, greasy and leave a white cast…. This one on the other hand was lightweight and didn't feel too heavy or greasy. I would most definitely keep this product in my sunscreen rotation.

Never have I ever regretted putting a product on my face almost immediately before I tried this stuff. I read up on the product before I tried it, making sure I could wear it under my makeup. I did my regular morning routine and used this instead of my usual sunscreen. It smelled like regular sunscreen, so no big deal there. It went on my skin nicely and I gave it time to soak in and dry. Finished my regular makeup and got in the car to head to work. I have a 45 minute commute in the Pacific Northwest, so not hot at all in the morning. By the time I got to work, my makeup was s l i d i n g off my face. I was a greasy, oily mess and it looked like it was the end of the day rather than the beginning. My boss even commented on it. I HATE this product. I would never recommend it to anyone and it's going straight in the trash. I'm just glad I got it as a free trial instead of spending money on it.

Like this as it is not as thick as normal sunscreen. It doesn't have a strong scent and it applies well! If you're not into the oily or glistening look, I would probably stay away but it does provide me with a hydrating look which I love!
It didn't leave a greasy feeling or a white cast. I have been looking for a good face sunscreen and this one will probably be my go to from now on.

I found this product to be greasy/oily on my skin. I appreciate that it's unscented and blends in nicely, but I can't get past the way it leaves my skin feeling. I think it would be fine if I wasn't wearing makeup or wanting a more matte look, but I can't justify using it as an every day sunscreen. I'll definitely keep this one in my beach bag for emergencies!

This is a great sunscreen! It is lightweight and not greasy. It played nice with makeup as well! It has helped prevent my fair skin from burning whether it is a pool day or being in and out if the house with kiddos all day! I plan to repurchase after it's empty!

This product has exceeded my expectations after using it for the past couple of weeks. Its lightweight and creamy texture made it perfect for everyday wear under my makeup. I found that it worked seamlessly with my other skincare and makeup products, and I appreciated that it didn't leave my face feeling oily.

The applicator tip was perfect! A little goes a long way. It almost feels like a serum, It plumps my skin and then feels like their is nothing on it. Does not leave my skin greasy like typical face sunscreens. I love this for every day use. I live in Miami, FL and the heat and humidity is NO JOKE! Sunscreen and a cap is the only way I am living these days :)

I enjoy the consistency of this product. It is lightweight, almost like a serum. It dries clear and doesn't pill or feel greasy, which many spf do. The smell is the only down side, it has a slight chemical odor that I don't enjoy. However, it is tolerable and I would still recommend.

avis.titre: Better than I thought it would be!
avis.texte: I've used this sunscreen for about 2 weeks so far and I'm actually enjoying it. I wish the bottle I received was a little bit bigger, because I love it for daily use. My skin felt nice and moisturized. And I love the way my skin plumped up and looked happy while using. I was having breakouts and I swear they started minimizing at a nice rate while using. The scent is also not bad like most sunscreens are. My favorite part is that it's spf 50 because that's pretty hard for me to find these days. Second favorite, is that there's no white cast. With having brown skin most sunscreens make me look like a ghost, but this didn't. For me this product is amazing and I will be getting more.
I use this in the morning after my facewash and it works well. Lightweight and does not leave too much of a caste. I'd recommend this.

Not a fan of this sunscreen. It had a horrible rubber smell. This is also advertised as being non greasy but it did not absorb well into the skin at all. I ended up wiping it off because I could not get past the smell and greasy feeling. I expected much better from such a well known brand.
After using this sunscreen once, I knew it was a good one! Lightweight, non-greasy, and moisturizing...it can't be beaten!
No white cast, works well under makeup and you don't need much to cover your face. Nice thin liquid, no strong smell. Did not make me breakout at all which I am prone to.

I have super dry and flaky skin on top of it being super sensitive. I was nervous about trying this product because a lot of sunscreens I've used in the past have caused irritation and redness. This sunscreen is great because it goes on light and hydrates. It also does not cause a stinging sensation if you put it around your eyes. I hate sunscreens that do that! It's comforting to have spf 50 in my early morning routine because I have had skin cancer scares in the past. Love this product

The good: This sunscreen is light, which makes it a good choice for body. It is moisturizing, which is good for people with drier skin. It is supposed to be waterproof and sweatproof though, so it would be a good choice for athletes. Light Moisturizing Waterproof and sweatproof The bad: Again, this smells like sunscreen. This is also too greasy and slightly sticky for me, even though I didn't use very much of it. My entire body becomes sticky and I usually need to shower immediately after I get home and out of the sun as I just couldn't stand the feeling.
I love this sunscreen primarily because I have a darkskin tone and this sunscreen rubs in very well and doesn't leave a white cast on my skin that's great

avis.titre: I really like the consistency of this product.
avis.texte: Love the consistency of this product, not oily, very thin and sits well under my makeup. Reminds me of the laroche posay one. No cons so far!

I love a lot about this sunscreen - it's super light and my skin looks really good with it on! The only issue I have is that it burns my eyes. That said, if I just put it on the rest of my face and then use another sunscreen near my eyes, I have no issues!

This worked so well. It goes on smoothly and doesn't pill up or get "peely" like some of the other facial sunscreens do. It protected my face when I was out in the sun for hours at a time. I didn't burn once. This is truly a great product. I have had trouble finding a facial sunscreen that I liked, but have found my go-to one with this product now.
Nice product kept skin feeling hydrated without having a sticky feeling and love the matte look and it doesn't peel after a while.

Let me preface by saying I'm particular with my facial sunscreen as I find it difficult to find ones that don't streak, aren't too white and don't pill after a couple of minutes. But this one doesn't do any of those things. I used it when I was in the Caribbean sun and it stood up against the heat and it didn't leave me looking like a ghost. It blends into the skin very well and provides the level of protection I need for my skin.

avis.titre: Helps me commit to wearing suscreen daily!
avis.texte: As I am getting closer to the end of my thirties, skincare has become increasingly more important to me. I always had many excuses for not using suscreen on my face on a daily basis, but Kiehls' Super Fluid Daily UV Defense has made it easier for me to commit to using sunscreen regularly. I really enjoy how easy it to apply and the fact that I have not noticed a white cast when I wear it. I'm not a huge fan of the initial smell, but I don't notice it after application.

This sunscreen is a light liquid facial sunscreen. It does not leave a white cast, but does provide a natural glow. The only downside is the sunscreen smell at first isn't very pleasant, but the smell goes away after about a minute. Overall I would purchase again.

I was so happy with this daily sunscreen by Kiehl's. It goes on your skin smoothly without any tackiness which I really appreciate! You can apply makeup over it without everything looking cakey. Highly recommend! This is my new go to!

this stuff is the best! i use it every day and notice a positive difference in my skin. the sunscreen works great, no need to reapply all day, i love how strong it is too. i absolutely recommend it to anyone!

I have fair skin and turn red quite rapidly in the sun. I found that this quickly absorbing moisturizer protected my face the entire day leaving me with no redness or sunspots. I was impressed with the non greasy formula quick absorption and softness that this lotion provided for my skin. This was my first time using the Kiehl's product but now I will definitely be a returning and reoccurring purchaser and user

After using this product for the past few weeks I am loving how lightweight it is. I recommend to wait about 2 minutes after applying moisturizer to then apply this sunscreen. I love that it is SPF 50+. It blends nicely and no white cast.

avis.titre: Ok for oily skin but careful around the eyes
avis.texte: Pro: lightweight, easy to blend, liquid consistency. No pilling or white cast Con: smell upon application (like wet cardboard with a hint of gasoline) but disappears afterwards, stung my eyes throughout the day Tried for 2 weeks with warm weather and colder. Skin: normal with dry patches and oily t zone

Reapplication is hassle free, leaves my skin with a healthy glow. Can use a tinted moisturizer on top if I want. SPF 50 is a HUGEEE plus. Doesn't aggravate my rosacea. Only one downside that I don't mind too much but find that maybe others will is that after a while I can "taste" a little bit of sunscreen if I lick my lips.
I can't say enough about this product. It's an amazing thing wearing lotion. It's almost like there is nothing in your skin. It does an amazing job and feels like a dream.

I found Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily UV Defense Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ to be lightweight and non-greasy. My friend and I, both with tan complexions, noticed it didn't leave a white cast on our skin. It does however have a strongish scent initially, which I cannot pinpoint what it smells like, however it fades quickly. Living on the southeast coast and spending a lot of time by the pool, we use sunscreen daily, and this one is a fantastic choice to keep the rays away.

I think since it says "super fluid" I was expecting it to be runnier and smoother on application, but it is still sort of thick in a way. However, it is super hydrating and suitable for sensitive skin.

This spf is lightweight and non greasy. I love how easily it blends into the skin. I prefer using it as a primer to keep my skin protected and to reduce piling. My skin does get a little oily but I live in a humid climate.
I like this product. It is lightweight and doesn't break me out. It feels like I have nothing on my skin.
This was given in exchange for. Review. This was a nice sunscreen. When applied don't leave a white residue. Felt nice and smooth on the skin.

2 d ago Pass on this one I received this product free through a bzzzagent campaign. It is lightweight, but felt greasy and like it sat on top of my skin. This caused major pilling when applied under foundation. The smell was also not great.

I used the super fluid daily sunscreen gifted by Kiehl's. It contains SPF 50. It's a lightweight sunscreen and doesn't make my skin feel greasy after use. There is no white cast and it blends well. It gives me good sun protection and I use it every day before stepping out.

avis.titre: Good and effective Sunscreen in decent price range
avis.texte: Bottle Design: Capacity: 50 ml Travel-Friendly: Small and compliant with flight size restrictions. Applicator: Includes a nice applicator on top for easy application. Smell: Scent: Typical sunscreen scent, not unpleasant or overpowering. White Cast: Appearance: No white cast after application. Spreadability: Spreads evenly and also moisturizes the skin. Ingredients: Contains Vitamin E, commonly found in moisturizers. Application & Feeling on Skin: Quantity: 5 drops are sufficient for even application on the face. Skin Feel: Hydrates the skin and provides a matte finish, which is a desirable feature. Sunscreen Effectiveness: Protection: Provides reliable sun protection without leaving a greasy residue.

avis.titre: I definitely would buy this product again!
avis.texte: After using this product for the past couple of weeks, I've enjoyed the results as it helps keep my dry skin hydrated and looking glowy. I did have some skin pilling when applied right on top of my moisturizer with no wait time in between, when used on it's own or if I waited for the moisturizer to sink in all good. The formula is fluid and smooth, very easy to apply & no white cast. I definitely recommend this product.

I loved this product! Super lightweight formula and not greasy at all. Dries quick but is moisturizing. I've been in Hawaii for 5 days and it's been an Everest's go to product for me. Would purchase again.

I applied as I would any other. Unfortunately it did leave a white residue or cast on my face when dried down. It was very lightweight which is great, also no harsh smells or irritation. It did leave my skin feeling greasy.

I recently tried the Super Fluid Daily UV Defense and appreciate its benefits, especially the high SPF 60+ protection. It's great to have that level of defense against harmful UV rays. However, I did notice some drawbacks. The formula leaves a noticeable white cast that sits on top of my skin, which is difficult to blend in. I tried applying makeup over it to minimize the white cast, but that resulted in a very glowy, almost oily effect on my skin, which wasn't ideal. While the product is lightweight, it does feel a bit greasy, which may not work well for those with oily or combination skin. Overall, it's a decent product for sun protection, but the white cast and greasiness are issues that might not make it a good fit for everyone.

I actually love this sunscreen. I don't recommend wearing it with a primer, but instead wear it AS A primer. It works great to keep the makeup on, but I made the mistake the first time wearing it on top of my primer and it piled. Shake it very well. It's not greasy at all in fact I'd describe it more as mattifying. I did receive it as a gift in exchange for my honest review. Honestly I would recommend this to anyone. Very travel friendly. Perfect for this mom on these long sports days stuck outside.

I have been using Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily UV Defense for a couple of weeks now and I absolutely love this product! It goes on smoothly and absorbs very well. My skin looks and feels amazing after applying it. I feel confident when I use Super Fluid Daily UV Defense because I know that I can trust that my skin is healthy and protected. I received a sample of Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily UV Defense in exchange of my honest opinion.

The bottle is small enough to bring with you in a small tote or backpack — perfect for on the go and reapplying! The product itself came on smoothly and didn't seem to leave a white cast that I noticed in photos. I also like how easy it was to apply makeup and not feel a greasy feeling.

avis.titre: Why haven't I used this sooner
avis.texte: I love how my face doesn't reject this product and it's not heavy on the skin

One of the better products I have used for sun care for my face. It is light and did not make the light makeup I use in summer pill. I have an oily tzone and it did not make me oily. I also have sensitive skin and it did not break me out.

avis.titre: Must add for summer skin care routine
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this product because I spent a lot more time outside this year because I just purchased my new home where I've been doing a lot more landscaping and spending time at the resident park by the swimming pool. This is a must have for any outdoor activities whether it's summer or winter. The formula is excellent for filling in fine lines and blending in without a white cast. It's not oily and it makes your skin look great. The only drawback is, I wish that it was waterproof. Besides that, it is a wonderful product and should be added to all skin care routines.

After about a week of daily wear, my skin tone appears more even, moisturized, and I haven't had problems with the product clogging my pores as compared to other basic sunscreens I've used. I haven't used foundation since using this product so happy with that for sure as I typically use foundation to even out my skin tone but the product is also super lightweight which is awesome. Some benefits of owning this product are increased UV protection, anti-aging benefits. I would likely buy this product in the future if at a reasonable price point. I would definitely recommend this product to my friends or family. Please note, I received this product in exchange for an honest review.
I'm a full time dog walker so I am always out in the sun! This spf works great and doesn't make my face feel greasy. Works great under make up or alone! No scent and no white cast.

avis.titre: No White Cast And Easily Blends And Absorbs
avis.texte: I have been using this sunscreen for the past few weeks and have found that it works great with my skin. I have combination skin that is slightly oily at the t-zone and normal to dry everywhere else. This blends in seamlessly and absorbs quickly without leaving a white cast and leaving my skin feeling greasy. I also appreciate that it doesn't make me break out like previous sunscreens have in the past. I will continue to purchase this in the future and have already recommended it to family and friends.

I've been using Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily UV Defense Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ and I'm really impressed with it. The formula is lightweight and non-greasy, making it perfect for the hot, sunny Florida climate where I live and where sunscreen is a must every day. The consistency is smooth and absorbs quickly without leaving any residue. I also love the sleek packaging, it's so convenient to toss in my bag and take on the go. This sunscreen has become a staple in my daily routine, providing excellent protection without the heavy feel.
The Kiehls Super fluid daily UV Defense sunscreen broad spectrum SPF 50+ has been very good on my skin. I apply it every morning and have noticed my face brighter and smoother .

I received this product in exchange for a review. Ok so as best I can tell it does work, as I haven't been sunburned when using it. While the smell isn't super strong it's not a good smell. It has somewhat of an awkward feeling on my skin after applying I can feel it sitting on the top layer of my skin not extremely weighted though. Overall it's an ok product just has some slight drawbacks.

I recently tried the Super Fluid Daily UV Defense, and I must say, it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. This lightweight formula offers excellent sun protection without leaving a greasy residue. It absorbs quickly and feels almost imperceptible on the skin, making it perfect for daily wear under makeup. What I love most is its broad-spectrum SPF, which gives me confidence during sunny days. The added hydration keeps my skin feeling fresh and smooth. Plus, it's suitable for all skin types, which is a huge plus! Overall, I highly recommend Super Fluid Daily UV Defense for anyone looking for effective sun protection that feels great on the skin.

I received this product for free in exchange for my review. My first thought was "who would pay this much for sunscreen?" But then I tried it. The consistency is wonderful. It feels so light that you can barely tell that it's on. I see some reviews mentioned that it smells bad. I didn't find this to be the case at all. I barely noticed any smell. Overall, I'm giving four stars because I didn't notice any benefit to my skin while using this product and the price is steep. But overall this is a great sunscreen with a quick drying matte finish.

This is a really good facial sunscreen, I really like the consistency and how it glides on the skin. There's no residue or greasiness. The price is a bit much for the size of the container but I try to remind myself it's a high quality product. I will probably use this every day during the summer as my sunscreen.

Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily Defense is fantastic. It's lightweight, applies smoothly, and absorbs quickly into the skin. I love that it's fragrance-free, as I'm very sensitive to scents. It works perfectly as a base for my makeup, with no issues setting my powders. I've also let my daughter, who has sensitive skin, use it, and it hasn't caused any problems for her. Overall, I highly recommend it to everyone.
Love this stuff! Goes on so smooth! Not greasy at all. I wear it under make up or just by itself if I'm going to lay by the pool. Feels light and fresh!

I really like my Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily UV Defense Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+. I like how it is fragrance free, non comodogenic and paraben free. It goes on smooth and layers great under my makeup. I never get sunburned using this daily. My only complaint is that the tube is so small. I would prefer more for the price. I received this product complimentary for my honest opinion.

I had been wanting to try this sunscreen for quite a while so was thrilled to receive it as a product for review. It is now my go-to sunscreen that I know I will be repurchasing. It ticks all the boxes for me: lightweight, non-greasy, layers well under make-up, no pilling, and best of all is SPF50+ which can be hard to find in such a light formula. It is fragrance free (another plus) but I love its natural scent; smells expensive and pleasant. Thrilled to have found this and have already recommended it to friends.

I took this product to a music festival and let all of my friends use it as well! We loved the formula, which was light weight and absorbed easily just as advertised. You do have to rub it in a bit, as it's a physical sunscreen. But it worked great as long as it was reapplied properly - no one got sunburned, which says a lot being in the sun all day every day for about a week. It also didn't bother my rather sensitive, dry skin - a win!

Living in Florida I have been looking for a good sunscreen. I love Kiehls products and was so excited to try this out! It goes on smooth, absorbs quickly, doesn't leave your face feeling shiny or sticky and doesn't leave a white residue. This product is absolutely amazing!!

This is hands down the best facial sunscreen I've tried, and I've used quite a few. It glides on and distributes easily, and soaks in without a trace. No residue, chalkiness or greasiness. The only thing I don't like is the price, but I do feel like I'm getting a high quality product for it. I can see myself using this as a daily summer sunscreen when I don't want any greasiness. I think it might work well on my winter dry skin, but I'll likely still use a more moisturizing SPF for those months.

I am not the best about using sunscreen on a daily basis (yes, even went outside and yes, even though I have fair skin). So when I was gifted this product as part of a promotion I made a point to utilize it. It has exceeded all my expectations. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue, making it perfect for daily wear and even better in hot and humid conditions! It provides excellent sun protection while feeling incredibly comfortable on my skin. I also appreciate that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin or interfere with my makeup. Overall, it's a fantastic sunscreen that delivers. Recommend for anyone looking for reliable and effective sun protection.

Liquidy and burns. I had high hopes that this would be creamy and moisturizing, but it's much more like old fashioned sunscreen that's really thin and difficult to apply. Got some near my eye and burned the rest of the day. If your skin is sensitive to sunscreen, I'd recommend a powder instead.

After using this sunscreen for about 2 weeks I have to admit it's one of the best "high end" sunscreens on the market. The application of the sunscreen is lightweight and goes on clear after lightly blending depending. It gives a nice glow in addition to keep your face protected from the sun. I say give it a try you can't wrong.

avis.titre: This product really protects you from the sun
avis.texte: I received this product for free for my honest review.After using this product for the past week,I can tell you that it's very liquidity.Its not oily at all drys right away.Its lightweight and it last a long time.It has a distinct smell to it.I usually prefer no scent at all.But this scent did not bother me like I thought it would.

This is a great formula, glides on skin smoothly and does not feel sticky. I really wanted to love this sunscreen as I am a big fan of their moisturizer. However it leaves a white cast on me. May be it doesn't work with my skin tone. Also I don't like the strong SPF smell it has. Overall I think this is a great formula but needs few improvements to justify the price tag.

Kiehl's sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent Super Fluid Daily UV Defense program. After several weeks of use, I have some thoughts to share: Kiehl's UV sunscreen has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that absorbs quickly and leaves a matte finish, making it suitable for daily use, especially for oily or combination skin. It doesn't leave a white cast and works well under makeup. The formulation is free from parabens, fragrances, and colorants, making it suitable for sensitive skin. However, it is more expensive than some other sunscreens and may not be available in all locations. Overall, it's a high-quality product that provides effective sun protection.

avis.titre: I feel good knowing its protecting my skin!
avis.texte: I like that this is 50SPF it is non greasy, light feeling and doesn't break me out. my skin feels smooth after putting it on which is nice compared to other face sun lotion i've tired. I took one star off for the smell, it's a little off putting but it dissipates fast. It can be a little pricey but Keihl's is a quality brand and you get what you pay for, and everything i have use dhas been helping my skin from this brand. Overall i recommend it and feel that it protects my sun damaged skin from Colorado full year long sun.
I like this formulation since its non-greasy, zinc oxide, so a physical sunscreen. it does not leave a whitecast and is quick to absorb into the skin. It has a light scent, which quickly dissapates.

avis.titre: Great Results From This Sunscreen Moisturizer
avis.texte: This spf moisturizer is awesome!! It goes on light and I have definitely noticed a difference in the fine lines around my eyes. My skin feels hydrated and protected from the sun as well.

I cannot say enough about this sunscreen. I recently bought another brand and it left my skin feeling like I had just rubbed tiny pebbles on my face... my makeup looked terrible and did not sit well. I started using this and for daily use, it's a game changer. Better absorption, better UV protection, better skin. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a daily sunscreen for under your makeup!

This Sunscreen has a thick consistency yet rubs in and is nicely absorbed by the skin. It gives me amazing UV Defense and my skin always feels protected when I use it. It hydrates and makes my skin soft and glowy. I definitely recommend this product.

This is very good Sunscreen that didn't take a whole lot to rub right into skin. It's lightweight and lasted a long time. I like the size because it can be carried easily in any bag. It is great for easy application on face and hands

I'm 43, and try to make sure I wear facial sunscreen daily. I've used many brands, and I can confidently say that this is one of the most long-lasting I've used. Many other high end brand are fine, but truly need to be re-applied almost hourly to stay effective, which honestly isn't practical. I like this sunscreen because it lasts multiple hours, which as a busy mom is a massive plus for me. I also like the gentleness (no breakouts), AND the higher SPF. Many of the other high end brands I have used max out at 35 SPF; I love that this one is 50. The only drawback in my opinion is the price. I know it's Kiehl's, an excellent brand, that offers superior quality, but there are just SO many options out there that still work fine but are in a lower price bracket. I received this sunscreen in exchange for my review, but I don't think I would spend quite this much for this type of product on my own.

I received this sunscreen complimentary from BzzAgent and Kiehls in exchange for my honest review. Ok, let me start by saying that this stuff smells God awful. I absolutely refused to put this on my face. The smell is like kerosine mixed with a bunch of awful chemicals and it cannot go on my sensitive face skin. I did try it out on my hand and although I didn't experience any adverse reactions, that smell lingered for a while and made me nauseous. I'm sorry but there is no way this doesn't have a bunch of unnecessary chemicals making it smell that way. And those chemicals should not be going on my face.

Love that I can now incorporate sunscreen as part of my skincare routine. This fluid is super lightweight and makes my skin feel hydrated and protected. Will definitely be incorporating into my skincare routine year round
So easy to use, works well and doesn't break out my skin. I love it!

avis.titre: Light weight and no white cast
avis.texte: I have used this sunscreen for a week and I like it. It is light weight and not thick. It has an SPF of 50. There is no smell to it which is great for people that are sensitive to that. There is not much of a white cast at all compared to other sunscreens. I usually put some sort of makeup or tinted moisturizer on top so you can't tell anyways. The applicator is also easy to use. I would highly recommend this to other people who are also brown skinned and looking for a light weight, high SPF sunscreen!

I got to try this Kiehl's Super Fluid Daily UV Defense for free through BzzAgent but the opinions here are based on my own experiences. This is something you wanna shake up before use. It does come out as a more thinner creamy liquid. It spreads well. It doesn't have a strong scent but I can smell the "sunblock" type scent to it but it is not bad. I applied before I left the house and tried to remember to reapply about every 2 hours. But this is not a water resistant protection so it does not help if you are swimming. I applied to my face and arms. It seems to work well. It has spf 50 and is supposed to protect against uva and uvb which is nice. I feel better when I am using spf as it will also help my skin. I found this non irritating. I didn't have an issue with breakouts after using. It didn't feel greasy or cakes. It was nice. I will use again.
Great sunscreen! Nice and lightweight and it layers well under makeup even with my oily skin. It hasn't broken me out which is a generally a problem with sunscreens that I use.

avis.titre: Super fluid daily uv defense sunscreen.
avis.texte: I would recommend and repurchase. I loved the fact that it wasn't too oily and it didn't break me out.

It's pricy but you only have one face/ body- take care of it! I'm the type of gal that does not go anywhere without sunscreen, even if im not wearing make up. I like that this sunscreen (although smells like sunscreen lol) is light weight and blends in well. I do my usual skincare routine and apply the sunscreen- wait a few minutes for it to dry then continue with my make up. I like how it has a high spf but is also moisturizing.
